data.title: Semester fee for summer semester 2027 due by 15 January 2027
data.summary: Hochschule Musterstadt confirms your re-registration for winter semester 2026/27. Re-registration for summer semester 2027 requires the semester fee of €312.40 to be received by 15 January 2027.
data.explanation: Your re-registration for winter semester 2026/27 is complete and your enrolment certificate (Immatrikulationsbescheinigung) is enclosed. For summer semester 2027, re-registration happens only by paying the semester fee (Semesterbeitrag) of €312.40. The money must arrive by 15 January 2027, and the registration period starts on 1 December 2026. Use the payment reference given. Late payment costs €15.00, and without timely re-registration you risk exmatriculation (Exmatriculation). From summer 2027 the Deutschlandsemesterticket is included in the fee. If you have a Deutschlandticket subscription, consider cancelling it in time.
data.tax_note: Semester fees and study costs may be deductible as education expenses; keep the payment proof and the enrolment certificate.

items.title: Pay semester fee for summer semester 2027
items.action: Transfer €312.40 to the university account using the given payment reference so it arrives by the due date.
items.consequence: A late payment fee of €15.00 applies, and without timely re-registration you risk exmatriculation (Exmatrikulation).
items.quote: Der Semesterbeitrag in Höhe von 312,40 € muss bis spätestens zum 15.01.2027 auf dem unten genannten Konto der Hochschule eingegangen sein.

items.title: Re-registration period begins
items.action: From this date you can pay the fee for summer semester 2027.

items.title: Cancel Deutschlandticket subscription if you have one
items.action: If you have a Deutschlandticket subscription, cancel it by 31 March 2027, since the Deutschlandsemesterticket is included in your fee.
items.quote: Falls Sie ein Deutschlandticket im Abonnement besitzen, denken Sie bitte daran, dieses rechtzeitig zum 31.03.2027 zu kündigen.

key_facts.label: Late payment fee (Säumnisgebühr)
key_facts.quote: Bei späterem Zahlungseingang wird eine Säumnisgebühr von 15,00 € erhoben.

key_facts.label: Semester ticket validity (gültig)
key_facts.quote: Nach der Urabstimmung der Studierendenschaft ist ab dem Sommersemester 2027 das Deutschlandsemesterticket im Semesterbeitrag enthalten (gültig 01.04.–30.09.2027).
